criteria.requirement: Repair Rich ANSI decoding by removing only the designated ignorable C0 characters already stripped from plain Text (NUL..BS, VT/FF, SO..SUB, FS..US) before recognizing escape sequences; preserve TAB/LF/CR handling. SGR sequences with such bytes after ESC or within parameters decode into actual styles. Unrecognized/truncated sequences never leave a raw ESC in emitted plain fragments; unsupported suffix text may remain literal. Preserve standard SGR/OSC8-ST links, colors and decoder style state. Document this limited parser policy rather than claim a complete arbitrary terminal-protocol sanitizer; do not reinterpret or execute terminal controls beyond existing supported sequences.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
